metadata.name: Harden-Runner
metadata.description: Harden-Runner provides runtime security for GitHub-hosted and self-hosted runners

inputs.name: allowed-endpoints
inputs.description: Only these endpoints will be allowed if egress-policy is set to block

inputs.name: denied-endpoints
inputs.description: These endpoints will be denied when endpoint blocking is enabled

inputs.name: egress-policy
inputs.description: Policy for outbound traffic, can be either audit or block

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: Used to avoid github rate limiting

inputs.name: disable-telemetry
inputs.description: Disable sending telemetry to StepSecurity API, can be set to true or false. This can only be set to true when egress-policy is set to block

inputs.name: disable-sudo
inputs.description: Disable sudo access for the runner account. Note: This parameter will be deprecated in the future. Please use disable-sudo-and-containers instead.

inputs.name: disable-sudo-and-containers
inputs.description: Disable sudo and container access for the runner account

inputs.name: policy
inputs.description: Policy name to be used from the policy store. Requires id-token: write permission.

inputs.name: api-key
inputs.description: StepSecurity API key for authenticating with the policy store. Required when use-policy-store is set to true.

inputs.name: use-policy-store
inputs.description: Set to true to fetch policy from the policy store using the API key. This is the preferred method over the policy input which requires id-token: write permission. Policies can be defined and attached at workflow, repo, org, or cluster (for ARC) level in the policy store. The most granular policy will apply.

inputs.name: deploy-on-self-hosted-vm
inputs.description: Set to true to deploy the Harden Runner agent directly on a self-hosted runner VM (Linux only). The recommended approach for self-hosted VMs is to bake the agent into the VM image; see docs.stepsecurity.io. Use this option only if baking is not possible, and only for ephemeral runners.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.description: StepSecurity customer name. Required in GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) environments for TLS checks, policy fetching, and direct self-hosted VM agent installation.

inputs.name: server-name
inputs.description: GHES server name registered with StepSecurity. Required in GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) environments for TLS checks, policy fetching, and direct self-hosted VM agent installation.
